plain: Shaped by hammering hot metal; also made as a fake or copy

webster.text: Hammered; beaten into shape; made; counterfeited.

example.quote: She broke in pieces the fetters which were forged for her, and showed that she was unassailable by force.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Pennsylvania Convention, Mr. WILSON, November 26, 1787 (2d ed. 1836)
